_comment: Intended resource-based policy for the graceful-gut-ai-dev-api Function URL.
This file is the reference copy; the live policy is managed with
'aws lambda add-permission' / 'aws lambda remove-permission' and can be read
back with 'aws lambda get-policy --function-name graceful-gut-ai-dev-api'.
<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID> is a placeholder. Substitute the real account ID at apply
time; it is deliberately not stored in this repository.
TWO statements are required, and both must be present for the Function URL
to serve traffic:
1. GracefulGutPublicInvokeUrl - lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl, conditioned on
the function URL auth type being NONE. This authorizes the URL itself.
2. GracefulGutPublicInvokeFunction - lambda:InvokeFunction, conditioned on
lambda:InvokedViaFunctionUrl. This authorizes the underlying invoke and
narrows it to requests that actually arrive through the Function URL.
A previous audit claimed statement 2 was redundant and it was removed. That
was wrong: without it the URL returns a steady 403 on every route. It
appears healthy for ~10-20s after removal only because of policy caching.
Do not remove it again.
ADMINISTRATOR ACTION REQUIRED. These statements grant Principal '*', so
changing them is an administrator task. The same applies to the Function URL
itself: creating one, or changing its AuthType or CORS configuration, is
administrator-only. The Claude dev role (GracefulGutAI-ClaudeDevRole) holds
none of lambda:AddPermission, lambda:RemovePermission,
lambda:CreateFunctionUrlConfig, or lambda:UpdateFunctionUrlConfig, and
cannot apply, repair, or remove any of it. Run the commands below with
administrator credentials.
The dev role can still READ all of it -- lambda:GetFunctionUrlConfig for the
URL, AuthType, and CORS, and lambda:GetPolicy for this resource policy -- so
verification does not need admin credentials.
The InvokedViaFunctionUrl condition is supported directly by the
--invoked-via-function-url flag, so CloudFormation, Terraform, and the
console are NOT required for it:
aws lambda add-permission \
--function-name graceful-gut-ai-dev-api --region us-east-2 \
--statement-id GracefulGutPublicInvokeUrl \
--action lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl --principal '*' \
--function-url-auth-type NONE
aws lambda add-permission \
--function-name graceful-gut-ai-dev-api --region us-east-2 \
--statement-id GracefulGutPublicInvokeFunction \
--action lambda:InvokeFunction --principal '*' \
--invoked-via-function-url
AuthType is NONE, so this policy intentionally allows anonymous callers to
reach the URL. Access control is enforced in application code by the X-GG-Key
shared-secret header, which is temporary internal-development protection
only and must never be shipped to a browser client. Before any public,
browser-facing client and before Phase 2 accepts free-text input, this
endpoint must move behind API Gateway with server-side abuse controls. See
the Phase 2 public-endpoint gate in CLAUDE.md.
